title: دنیای بصری نسخه‌ی وب مازستا
question: قرعه، دنیای «برد مادر» را انتخاب کرد. همین را نگه دارید، یک جایگزین بردارید، یا دوباره قرعه بکشید.

options.label: Silkscreen — the board is the interface
options.lineage: high-end matte-black motherboards: gold ENIG pads, white silkscreen, reference designators, test points
options.thesis: Every page is a region of a black PCB; every reading sits on a gold test point with its reference designator.
options.viewport: Dashboard as the board top view: CPU socket, GPU slot, DIMM slots and M.2 as silkscreened footprints, live values on their test points, traces animating between them.
options.risk: Fails if the board becomes decoration; every footprint has to be a real, clickable part of the machine.

raised.raise: A reading that was not measured is hatched with diagonal silkscreen stripes, never a 0.
Monitoring keeps true data density: tabular figures, one data face, no padding for looks.
The one number that matters per part is set at monumental scale, like an instrument readout.
Temperature has thresholds that re-tint the part's copper from cool to hot, so state reads without a legend.

options.label: Bench Meter
options.lineage: the yellow-holstered bench multimeter every technician owns
options.thesis: The app as the meter on the bench: yellow holster, dark LCD, a rotary dial that selects what you measure.
options.viewport: A dial of pages on the side, a big LCD readout pane with hold/min/max, probes as the test queue.
options.risk: The most familiar reading of a yellow-and-black tool brand; close to what a hardware tool is expected to look like.

options.label: Terminal Wayfinding
options.thesis: Navigation as yellow overhead bands: each page shows only the next decisions, with big numbers.
options.viewport: A yellow band across the top naming the page and the next actions; content below in black and white.
options.case: Fuses cleanly with the brand yellow and wins on clarity; loses on audience, technicians do not live in airports.
options.risk: Can read as signage wallpaper if every block becomes a yellow band.

options.label: Signal Bench
options.lineage: CRT oscilloscope with an etched graticule
options.thesis: Every sensor is a trace on a ten-division graticule; you move by timebase, not by page.
options.viewport: A large graticule with CPU and GPU traces overlaid, readouts in instrument caps below.
options.case: Technicians know the instrument, so it holds audience; loses on clarity for reports, settings and queues.
options.risk: Everything that is not a waveform feels bolted on.

options.label: Industrial Quote Grammar
options.lineage: industrial streetwear labels and hazard stripes
options.thesis: Every zone named in straight quotes, hazard stripes under what matters.
options.viewport: Quoted zone labels over striped plates.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a fashion joke, not a workshop instrument.
options.kept: The diagonal hatch as the one state for unavailable.

options.label: Datamatics
options.thesis: Pure black and white bar fields and sine lattices.
options.viewport: A strobing data field with monospace columns.
options.case: Loses both: no brand yellow, and art-strobe over readable state.
options.risk: Strobing is hostile at a workbench.

options.label: Crisis Wall
options.thesis: Orange phosphor, chevron bands, seven-segment countdowns.
options.viewport: A black wall of framed label blocks around a schematic.
options.case: Loses both: costume over the brand, alarm energy everywhere.
options.kept: Monumental scale for the one number that matters.

options.label: Mesophotic Dive
options.lineage: technical dive computers and reef walls
options.thesis: Descend by depth; light and colour change with the stage.
options.viewport: A vertical dive profile with pinned observations.
options.case: Loses both: unrelated to the shop and off-brand blue.
options.risk: A metaphor the technician has to decode.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark hardware-monitor dashboard with cards, gauges and a sidebar, executed with care.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar on the right, a grid of part cards with sparklines, the brand yellow as accent.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every monitoring tool, including the WPF edition.
